groups.passage:
Urban Rooftops Turn Green

Across the city of Marlowe, a growing number of commercial buildings are covering their rooftops with vegetation. [1] Since the city council introduced a property-tax reduction for green roofs three years ago, the number of such installations has more than tripled, according to the municipal planning office.

Supporters point to several advantages. Plant cover absorbs rainwater that would otherwise overwhelm the city's aging drainage system, and it insulates buildings, lowering heating and cooling costs. [2] Some owners have gone further, leasing rooftop space to urban farmers who grow vegetables for nearby restaurants.

Critics, however, caution that the benefits are not automatic. [3] A poorly designed green roof can leak or place excessive weight on older structures, and maintenance costs can be considerable. “Owners need a structural survey before they plant anything,” said engineer Tobias Lindgren. [4] The council has responded by publishing a free design guide and by requiring inspections before green roofs are installed on any building constructed before 1960.

questions.prompt:
In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong?
“One office tower on Fenwick Street reported a 15 percent drop in its annual energy bill.”
questions.explain: Câu chèn là ví dụ minh họa cho ý mái xanh cách nhiệt và "lowering heating and cooling costs", nên đứng ngay sau câu đó, tức vị trí [2].

questions.prompt: What is one requirement introduced by the city council?
choices: All new buildings must have green roofs.
Urban farmers must register with the city.
Owners must write their own design guides.
Older buildings must be inspected before a green roof is added.
questions.explain: Hội đồng yêu cầu kiểm tra trước khi lắp mái xanh trên mọi tòa nhà xây trước năm 1960 ("requiring inspections before green roofs are installed"). Hướng dẫn thiết kế do hội đồng phát hành miễn phí.

Text 1: Notice
Attention, Tenants of Mercer Point Apartments

The building's water supply will be shut off on Tuesday, 11 March, from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. while plumbers replace the main valve in the basement. We recommend that residents store drinking water in advance. The laundry room and the fitness center on the ground floor will also be closed during these hours.

If the work cannot be finished on Tuesday, it will continue on Wednesday, 12 March, during the same hours. Updates will be posted in the lobby and sent by text message to all residents registered for alerts with the management office.

— Mercer Point Management Office
-----
Text 2: Email
To: office@mercerpoint.com
From: Rahul Iyer, Apartment 6C
Date: 7 March
Subject: Water shut-off

Hello,
I saw the notice in the lobby about next week's water shut-off. I run a small baking business from my apartment, and I have a large order to prepare on Wednesday morning, so I would like to know as soon as possible if the work is extended. However, I moved in only last month and do not think I have signed up for your text alerts. Could you add my number, 555-0148, to the list?

Also, will the parking garage be affected?

Thank you,
Rahul Iyer

questions.prompt: Why will the water be shut off?
choices: A part of the plumbing system will be replaced.
The water pipes will be cleaned.
The water quality will be tested.
questions.explain: Thông báo nói thợ ống nước sẽ "replace the main valve in the basement" — thay van chính.

questions.prompt: According to the notice, what will be closed during the work?
questions.explain: "The laundry room and the fitness center on the ground floor will also be closed during these hours." Gara đỗ xe không được nhắc tới.

questions.prompt: Why does Mr. Iyer want to receive updates?
choices: He needs water for his work on Wednesday.
He is planning to move out.
He is in charge of the building.
questions.explain: Ông làm bánh tại nhà và có đơn hàng lớn phải chuẩn bị sáng thứ Tư, đúng ngày công việc có thể kéo dài nếu chưa xong.

questions.prompt: What is most likely true about Mr. Iyer?
choices: He wrote the notice in the lobby.
He would not currently receive the text message updates.
He lives on the ground floor.
He will be away on 11 March.
questions.explain: Tin nhắn chỉ gửi cho cư dân đã đăng ký nhận thông báo (thông báo), mà ông nói mình chưa đăng ký nhận text alerts (email).

questions.prompt: What does Mr. Iyer ask about that the notice does not mention?
questions.explain: Ông hỏi "will the parking garage be affected?"; thông báo chỉ nói về phòng giặt và phòng gym, không nhắc gara.

Text 1: Web page
Pinecrest Language Academy — Business English Courses (Autumn Term)

Course | Format | Length | Fee
Business Writing | In person, Mondays | 10 weeks | $380
Presentation Skills | In person, Thursdays | 8 weeks | $340
Negotiation English | Online, live sessions on Tuesdays | 8 weeks | $310
Email Essentials | Online, self-paced | 6 weeks | $150

Students who enroll in two or more courses receive 15% off the total fee. All in-person classes take place at our Garland Avenue campus. Companies registering five or more employees should contact our corporate team for group rates.
-----
Text 2: Email
To: enroll@pinecrestlang.com
From: Sofia Marangoni
Date: 28 August
Subject: Course registration

Hello,
I would like to register for two of your autumn business courses. My new position involves regular meetings with suppliers in Asia, so I want a course that will help me reach agreements more effectively. I also need to improve my ability to give talks to large groups, which is something I find quite stressful.

Since I travel for work most Tuesdays, could you tell me whether the live online sessions are recorded? If they are not, I may have to choose a different course.

Kind regards,
Sofia Marangoni

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the email?
choices: To enroll and ask about a course format
questions.explain: Bà Marangoni muốn đăng ký hai khóa và hỏi các buổi học trực tuyến trực tiếp có được ghi lại không.

questions.prompt: Which course would most help Ms. Marangoni in her dealings with suppliers?
questions.explain: Bà cần khóa giúp "reach agreements more effectively" với nhà cung cấp — tức đàm phán, ứng với khóa Negotiation English.

questions.prompt: If Ms. Marangoni enrolls in Negotiation English and Presentation Skills, how much will she pay in total?
questions.explain: $310 + $340 = $650; đăng ký từ hai khóa được giảm 15%, nên còn $650 × 0.85 = $552.50.

questions.prompt: Why might Ms. Marangoni have difficulty attending one of the courses?
choices: It meets on a day when she usually travels.
It is held at the Garland Avenue campus.
It is available only to groups.
questions.explain: Khóa Negotiation English học trực tuyến vào thứ Ba (trang web), mà bà đi công tác hầu hết các ngày thứ Ba (email).

questions.prompt: In the email, the word “reach” in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to
questions.explain: "reach agreements" nghĩa là đạt được thỏa thuận, nên "reach" gần nghĩa nhất với achieve.

Text 1: Memo
To: All staff, Brennan & Vos Architects
From: Charlotte Vos, Managing Partner
Date: 2 May
Subject: Office move

As announced last month, we will relocate from our Kingsley Road office to Halden Tower on Quay Street. Departments will pack and move on different days during the week of 26 May so that client work is not interrupted, and the new office will open on Monday, 2 June. Please consult the attached schedule. Before your department's packing deadline, place your personal items in the labeled crates supplied by Torvik Movers. Large models and drawings should not be packed by staff; the movers will handle them with specialist equipment.
-----
Text 2: Moving schedule
Department | Packing deadline | Moving day
Accounts | Friday, 23 May, 5 P.M. | Monday, 26 May
Design | Monday, 26 May, 5 P.M. | Tuesday, 27 May
Engineering | Tuesday, 27 May, 5 P.M. | Wednesday, 28 May
Client Services | Wednesday, 28 May, 5 P.M. | Thursday, 29 May
IT equipment for all departments will be moved on Friday, 30 May.
-----
Text 3: Email
To: Charlotte Vos
From: Ibrahim Haddad, Engineering
Date: 20 May
Subject: Moving day

Hi Charlotte,
I have just learned that the Leighton Bridge client will be visiting our current office on the morning of our department's moving day to review the structural plans. Since the visit was arranged months ago and the client is traveling from abroad, I would prefer not to postpone it. Would it be possible for Engineering to swap days with Client Services? I have already spoken to Mei Tanaka, who leads that team, and she has no objection. I can also confirm that our three bridge models are ready to be collected by the movers.

Best,
Ibrahim

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the memo?
choices: To give instructions about a relocation
To ask for volunteers to help with packing
questions.explain: Bản ghi nhớ thông báo chuyển văn phòng sang Halden Tower và hướng dẫn nhân viên xem lịch, đóng đồ cá nhân vào thùng.

questions.prompt: On what date is the Leighton Bridge client scheduled to visit?
questions.explain: Khách đến vào sáng ngày chuyển của phòng Engineering (email), và lịch ghi Engineering chuyển vào thứ Tư, 28/5.

questions.prompt: If Mr. Haddad's request is approved, when will Engineering's packing deadline be?
questions.explain: Ông xin đổi ngày với Client Services; theo lịch, hạn đóng gói của Client Services là thứ Tư, 28/5, lúc 5 giờ chiều.

questions.prompt: What is implied about the bridge models?
choices: Mr. Haddad has packed them in crates.
They will be displayed to the client at Halden Tower.
They will be moved by specialists rather than by staff.
They have already been sent to the client.
questions.explain: Bản ghi nhớ nói mô hình lớn không do nhân viên đóng gói mà công ty chuyển nhà xử lý; email cho biết các mô hình cầu "ready to be collected by the movers".

questions.prompt: Who most likely is Ms. Tanaka?
choices: The head of the Client Services department
A member of the Leighton Bridge client team
A managing partner of the firm
questions.explain: Ông Haddad xin đổi ngày với Client Services và nói đã trao đổi với Mei Tanaka, "who leads that team" — bà là trưởng nhóm Client Services.
